title: GitHub: sebbbi/NoGraphicsAPI
description: Stars: 786, Forks: 18 | Minimal graphics API. Built on top of latest Vulkan extensions. As close as possibly to my "No Graphics API" blog post and the SIGGRAPH talk.

ko.title: NoGraphicsAPI: 최소한의 Vulkan 기반 그래픽스 API

en.title: NoGraphicsAPI: Minimal Vulkan‑Based Graphics API
